name: Iimura Manami
source:
She is a pharmacist at Jomiya General Hospital. She is Hiroko Sugimura's best friend. She has a fiancé.

When she finds out that Hiroko is being blackmailed, she tries to report it to the police.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1327]Getchu[/url]]
